turns.assessment: The outage is an abrupt, bidirectional loss on the S03–S16 line. OSC_LOS on oms.S03-S16.span2 and oms.S16-S03.span0 identifies the two opposite-direction fibres of the same 90.5 km cable segment; the downstream amplifier input losses and simultaneous loss of all channels corroborate this localization. This pattern strongly indicates a physical cable cut rather than an amplifier, connector, channel, or switching fault.

proposals.rationale: E8 is the S03→S16 fibre of the affected 90.5 km segment. Its OSC loss is paired with OSC loss on reverse-direction E14, as expected when both fibres in one cable are cut. Abrupt all-channel loss and downstream amplifier input/output loss support a hard fibre break.
An extreme span-loss increase could also suppress both payload and OSC, but the abrupt complete bidirectional loss is more characteristic of a cut.
